_comment: Verbatim quotes for #reviews in display order: only reviews FACTS section 14 marks ELIGIBLE (5 stars, Google-labelled on the club's own page, full text matched 2026-10-02; _build/facts/reviews-verification.json). Left out on purpose: Marianne (F-REV-05) and everything FACTS does not mark eligible. Eligible but held back (the section shows at most 5): F-REV-08, F-REV-09, F-REV-10, F-REV-13. Rating, count and the Google link come from reviews.json. reviews.js shows a quote only if stars === 5, verified !== false, origin === 'google' and, where reviews.json has the same author, that text (minus a trailing ellipsis) starts ours. Not re-read on Google itself.

quotes.author: Tom J.
quotes.text: Top-level equipment, strong classes, and real recovery facilities but what stands out most is the atmosphere. People train seriously, then genuinely socialise afterward.

quotes.author: Åsmund Tveitevoll
quotes.text: Fantastic equipment, great aircondition and high level of service. A real gem in Bali: lots of Arsenal equipment, solid platforms and lots of space!

quotes.author: Skye D.S.
quotes.text: A welcoming, laid-back space with genuinely friendly people and a restaurant worth staying for. It feels less like a gym and more like a community.

quotes.author: Joy F.
quotes.text: Spent a full day trying every facility; gym, pool, recovery, and the restaurant. The macro-friendly menu made post-workout meals easy. Will definitely be back.

quotes.author: asyraf140796
quotes.text: Awesome gym. Amazing natural lighting. Good equipment. Friendly staff !
